---
title: Installation
guide-section: "Getting started"
---

Whittaker targets Python 3.10+ and is not yet on PyPI. Once released:

```bash
pip install whittaker
```

## Optional extras

The core package depends only on Narwhals, NumPy, SciPy, and `typing_extensions`.
Backend- and feature-specific pieces are optional extras:

| Extra | Adds |
|---|---|
| `pd` | pandas |
| `pl` | Polars |
| `pa` | PyArrow |
| `formula` | formulaic (alternative formula parsing) |
| `altair` | Altair + vl-convert (visualization) |
| `tables` | Great Tables (publication tables) |
| `fast` | numba (accelerated kernels) |
| `all` | pd, pl, pa, formula, altair, tables |

```bash
pip install "whittaker[all]"
```

## From source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/rich-iannone/whittaker.git
cd whittaker
make install   # pip install -e ".[dev]"
make check     # ruff + pyright + pytest
```
